news.text: #GRABARA SHOCK: ACL TEARAt 6 PM #Juve-#AtalantaMore problems for #Spalletti. The Pole got injured during training: out 6-7 months. Assault on #Sarri with #Nico and #Kolo. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

NEW #KOLO, NEW #JUVEAt 6 PM against #Atalanta. #Grabara shock: cruciate ligamentHe will alternate as a winger with #Nico just like in the Europa League. And forward with the 3-man defense. Season over for the goalkeeper.[Front Page TuttoSport]
#Juventus are evaluating to sign a new goalkeeper after Grabara’s injury. #Juve are exploring the free agents market to find a good solution. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🧤⁉️ "Regarding the situation of the #Juventus goalkeeper, they will need to evaluate the free agents. The bianconero management will have to decide who to go after. Alternatively, there would be the possibility of promoting #Radu, born in 2007 from the #NextGen.[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

MEDICAL UPDATE | KAMIL GRABARAFollowing a sprain to his right knee sustained during training this afternoon, Kamil Grabara underwent diagnostic tests at J|medical.The tests revealed a tear to the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee. The player will undergo orthopaedic consultations in the coming days to determine the course of treatment.[Juventus]
